Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_TimeBu: Stops starting new farming operations after this time. One operation can exceed the limit. Increase only if backlog persists and the server has spare processing time. Default: 2 ms.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_Adjust: Every ten game minutes, unfinished work raises the operation allowance by this amount. Finishing with more than 10% of ticks to spare lowers it. This is a tuning step, not a fixed plant count. Default: 5.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_MaxOpe: Maximum automatically tuned allowance. The time budget still applies. Operations include health, water/disease, checks and plot cleanup; they are not unique plants. Default: 10000.
